proposal.reason: Primary change is GIN behavior: adds timed GIN signal waits, GIN-only window registration flow, and stricter cross-rank/backend/stride validation for GIN connectivity and context setup. Include device-api because the PR also makes independently substantive public API/ABI-semantic updates (device API version 2.2.2 fields, bounded requirements/properties compatibility handling, and explicit LSA pointer/query behavior changes for GIN-only windows).
